proves.claim: clause 1: jobs.expediteMax is a described repo setting with default 3, read as 3 when unset through the same read as claims.itemsInGateMax.

config.settings-expedite-max.default-thr.why: Keeps the coordinator expedite cap declared, described and defaulting to 3 so a person can find and set it (#11809).

proves.claim: A jobs.expediteMax in the repo policy is kept by the config read and resolves, not stripped as an unknown key.

config.settings-expedite-max.configured-.why: The compat schema had no jobs section, so a configured jobs.expediteMax was stripped and the default always won.
